ref_name._comment: MERGE TARGETS ONLY — list branches you merge INTO, never a glob over branches you work ON. These rules gate PUSHES to any matching ref, so `refs/heads/feat/**` makes every feature branch reject your own commits with GH013 until they go through their own PR. GitHub rulesets cannot express 'gate this ref when it is a PR base but allow pushes when it is a PR head', so a stacked PR's base has to be listed by hand for as long as the stack is open, and removed after.
